iosWidgetsGuidance.selectAction.title: Select your actions
iosWidgetsGuidance.selectionAction.subti:
While in edit mode, tap the widget to choose how the widget should control your lights.

Tip: Did you know you could add a widget to your Lock Screen? While on that screen, tap and hold, and then tap Customize.

Add shortcuts to your widgets in the Shortcuts app. Search "Hue" and create your own actions.
